newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks firm, buoyed by surge in tech sector.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks firm, buoyed by surge in tech sector.

text.p: U.S. blue chips backed off slightly after a midday rally on Tuesday, but share prices remained supported by solid gains in the technology sector and the Nasdaq composite index.

The Dow was up 30 points at 7376, shy of an intraday high of 7393.30, after retracing earlier declines. But breadth remained negative, with declining issues outnumbering advancing issues on the New York Stock Exchange by 13 to 11.
Nasdaq, heavily weighted by technology shares, was up 15 points at 1405. Stock prices rose despite weakness in the long bond, which was off 17/32 at a 7.03 percent yield.
